title: Hybrid woman with skateboard in the grocery store

tellings.quote: this woman is walking in in front of me and I hit I'm hit by a brilliant It's one of them.

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with beings he believes are not human, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a moment in a grocery store near Santa Monica, California, around 2024. He says a woman with a skateboard walked in front of him and he was hit by a sudden, brilliant certainty that she was "one of them," a hybrid of human and non-human. If true, it would mean such beings live among ordinary people unnoticed.
